name: Remove roadmap internals: delete the template and tombstone the command body, so a preserved .claude/commands/awos/roadmap.md wrapper resolves to a removal notice instead of a broken import (context/product/roadmap.md is untouched)

content: `/awos:roadmap` was removed in AWOS 2.0. AWOS is not a planning or backlog tool: specs are anchored by an explicit topic now, not by a roadmap item.
Tell the user the following, then stop. Do not build, update, or review a roadmap document.
- This command no longer exists. To start a feature, run `/awos:spec` and state the topic directly.
- If `context/product/roadmap.md` exists, it is theirs to keep, mine for spec topics, or delete — AWOS no longer reads or maintains it.
- This notice comes from a leftover command wrapper. To remove it, delete `.claude/commands/awos/roadmap.md` and `.awos/commands/roadmap.md`.
